school.name: James Clancy
school.title: Head Coach · Campus Athletic Director
school.bio: Clancy has led Klein Cain since the program opened in 2017, with district titles in 2022 and 2024 and six straight playoff berths through 2025.

Humble.name: Robert Murphy
Humble.title: Head Coach
Humble.bio: Murphy is in his fourth season at Humble and is trying to lift the Wildcats back into the playoffs for the first time since 2019.

Oak Ridge.name: Tyler Blackshire
Oak Ridge.title: Head Coach · Campus Athletic Director
Oak Ridge.bio: Blackshire took over at Oak Ridge in 2025 and returns 13 starters while trying to end back-to-back playoff misses.

Tomball.name: Dave Handal
Tomball.title: Head Coach
Tomball.bio: Handal has won a playoff game in all four of his full seasons at Tomball and is working through heavy turnover on this year’s roster.

Magnolia West.name: Ben McGehee
Magnolia West.title: Head Coach
Magnolia West.bio: McGehee is in his sixth season at Magnolia West and has spent this fall rebuilding culture after three total wins across the last two 6A seasons.

Klein Collins.name: Adrian Mitchell
Klein Collins.title: Head Coach
Klein Collins.bio: Mitchell has taken Klein Collins to the playoffs in all eight of his seasons and reached the regional semifinals in each of the last two years.

Klein.name: Nick Codutti
Klein.title: Head Coach
Klein.bio: Codutti returned Klein to the playoffs in his first season and gets quarterback Carter Lattelle back from an ACL injury this fall.

Klein Oak.name: Brandon Carpenter
Klein Oak.title: Head Coach
Klein Oak.bio: Carpenter’s Panthers lost three one-score district games last year and missed the playoffs for the third time in four seasons.

Tomball Memorial.name: Joe Dale Cary
Tomball Memorial.title: Head Coach
Tomball Memorial.bio: Cary is in his third season at Tomball Memorial, where the defense allowed 42 or more in seven district games a year ago.

Magnolia.name: Craig Martin
Magnolia.title: Head Coach
Magnolia.bio: Martin has won nine games in two of the last three seasons at Magnolia and has reached the playoffs in five of his seven years there.

Klein Forest.name: Darrick Vaughn
Klein Forest.title: Head Coach
Klein Forest.bio: Vaughn’s Eagles finished 2–8 for the second straight year and must replace most of an offense that scored well in 2025.
